services.name: Luxury vinyl plank
services.blurb: Waterproof plank with the wear layer printed on your quote, so you know what you are buying.

services.name: Engineered hardwood
services.blurb: Real wood top layer over a stable core, glued or floated over slabs and upstairs alike.

services.name: Solid hardwood
services.blurb: Nail-down solid oak for wood subfloors, sanded and finished in place.

services.name: Tile & stone floors
services.blurb: Porcelain and stone set flat over a membrane in kitchens, baths and mudrooms.

services.name: Slab moisture testing
services.blurb: We read the moisture in your slab before any floor goes down, and show you the number.

services.name: Floor leveling
services.blurb: Dips and humps ground or filled so long planks lie flat and do not click or bounce.

services.name: Carpet for bedrooms
services.blurb: Bedroom and stair carpet with the pad weight listed, stretched tight with seams out of the walkway.

services.name: Hardwood refinishing
services.blurb: Scratched or gray hardwood sanded to bare wood and refinished in the color you pick.

services.name: Stairs
services.blurb: Treads, risers and nosings in wood or vinyl to match the floor at the top of the stairs.

services.name: Samples at your house
services.blurb: We bring the samples to your rooms and lay them in your own light before you choose.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I had three vinyl quotes and no way to compare them. Simone wrote the wear layer and thickness next to each one, and the cheap one turned out to be half as thick. Went with the 12 mil.
reviews.name: Danielle P.

reviews.text: They tested our basement slab before quoting and the reading was too high for the wood I wanted. Engineered on a moisture barrier instead. Two summers in and no cupping.
reviews.name: Kevin O.

reviews.text: Our 1960s ranch had a dip in the hallway you could feel in socks. They ground and filled it before the plank went down. Nothing clicks underfoot now.
reviews.name: Gloria T.

reviews.text: Brought samples to the house and laid them by the big window at four in the afternoon. The gray I loved in the store looked green in our light. Glad we checked.
reviews.name: Nate H.

reviews.text: Bathroom tile is flat and the grout lines run straight out the door into the hall. They showed me the membrane under it before setting a single tile.
reviews.name: Imani J.

reviews.text: Refinished the oak in our Kirkwood bungalow. They told me which boards were too thin to sand again and replaced those first. It looks like the house finally got a haircut.
reviews.name: Chris L.

reviews.text: Carpet in three bedrooms, pad weight written on the quote, seams nowhere near the doorways. The installers took the old carpet with them and vacuumed.
reviews.name: Ruth M.

proof.guarantee: If a plank or tile we laid lifts, gaps or cracks in 2 years, we replace it and pay the labor.
